column1: # subject-pins.tsv — GENERATED. Regenerate with `python tools/govkit/govkit.py selfcheck --write`.
# One row per gate leg in tools/gate-legs.json: <name>\t<subject>\t<chunk>. TWO fields
# decide whether a leg runs on an automatic bar, and tools/run-gates/run-gates.sh is the
# code that decides: it HOLDS a leg when `subject == kit` OR `chunk == selftests`, and
# runs it otherwise. Both are pinned here, because pinning one left the other free to
# take a leg off every bar with nothing in a diff to see (TOOL-aScouredKit-3).
# THIS FILE GRADES CHANGE, NOT CORRECTNESS. It exists so a subject cannot move without
# the move appearing in a diff. Whether any given value is RIGHT is a review judgement
# — the criterion is stated once, at the `subject` field declaration in
# tools/run-gates/run-gates.sh: ask what a FAILURE of the leg MEANS.
harness arms (fail branches armed or pinned)
python resolver (behaviour + inline parity + idiom ban)
testsuite counts (every bar self-test prints one)
verdict epoch (kit version dates the engine)
